name: (a) pose-supported hand moves from the side to the chin over 1 s
(a2) handedness-fallback hand moves from the side to the chin over 1 s
(b) pose-supported hand appears directly at the chin with no history
(c) a gap longer than 300 ms loses the entry
(c2) a gap of 250 ms keeps the entry when the motion is plausible
(d) after entering, a hand held at the chin beyond 1500 ms stays accepted while tracked
(e) real right hand, then a face false positive 125 ms later
(f) same palm size, 250 ms later, too far away for the elapsed time
(g) fast real motion, 0.5 sw per 125 ms, from the side to the chin
(h) palm size jumps x2 in one frame at the face boundary: track restarts, entry lost
(h2) palm size jumps x2 in one frame outside the face: track restarts, still accepted
take: entry happens inside the take
take: starts with the hand already at the chin
